𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄

THE ANCIENT COVENANT RECORD

Volume Seven — Part One

The Book of Yovelim

YOVELIM

The Book of Jubilees — Part One

Chapters 1 through 25

YOVELIM — CHAPTER 1 YHWH Speaks to Moshe on Sinai — The Heavenly Tablets Revealed

1:1 It happened in the first year of the exodus of the children of Yisra'EL out of Mitzrayim, in the third month, on the sixteenth day of the month, that YHWH spoke to Moshe, saying: Come up to me on the mountain; I will give you the two tablets of stone of the law and of the commandment, which I have written, that you may teach them.

1:2 Moshe went up into the mountain of YHWH; the glory of YHWH remained on Mount Sinai; a cloud overshadowed it six days.

1:3 he called to Moshe on the seventh day out of the midst of the cloud; the appearance of the glory of YHWH was like a flaming fire on the top of the mountain.

1:4 Moshe was on the mountain forty days and forty nights; YHWH taught him the earlier and the later history of the division of all the days of the law and of the testimony.

1:5 he said: Incline your heart to every word which I will speak to you on this mountain; write them in a book, so that their generations may see how I have not abandonn them for all the evil which they have done in transgressing the covenant which I establish between me and you for their generations this day on Mount Sinai.

1:6 thus it will happen when all these things come upon them, that they will recognize that I am more righteous than they in all their judgments and in all their actions; they will recognize that I have been truly with them.

1:7 now write for yourself all these words which I declare to you this day, for I know their rebellion and their stubbornness, before I bring them into the land of which I swore to Avraham, to Yitzhak; to Yaakov, saying: To your seed will I give a land flowing with milk and honey.

1:8 they will eat and be satisfied; they will turn to strange gods - to gods that cannot deliver them from any of their tribulation - and this witness will be heard for a witness against them.

1:9 Because they will forget all my commands, even all that I command them; they will walk after the nations; after their uncleanness; after their shame; will serve their gods; these will prove to them an offense; a tribulation; an affliction; a snare.

1:10 many will be destroyed; they will be taken captive; will fall into the hands of the enemy, because they have abandonn my statutes; my commands; the feasts of my covenant; my Sabbaths; my holy place which I have made holy for myself in their midst; my tabernacle; my sanctuary which I have made holy for myself in the midst of the land, that I should set my name upon it; that it should dwell there.

1:11 they will make for themselves high places; groves; carved images; they will each of them worship their own images, going astray; they will sacrifice their children to demons; to every work of the error of their hearts.

1:12 I will send witnesses to them, that I may witness against them, but they will not hear; will kill the witnesses also; they will persecute those who seek the law; they will abrogate and change everything so as to work evil before my eyes.

1:13 I will hide my face from them; I will deliver them into the hand of the nations for captivity; for a prey; for devouring; I will remove them from the midst of the land; I will scatter them among the nations.

1:14 they will forget all my law; all my commands; all my judgments; will go astray as to new moons; Sabbaths; feasts; jubilees; statutes.

1:15 after this they will turn to me from among the nations with all their heart; with all their soul; with all their strength; I will gather them from among all the nations; they will seek me, so that I will be found of them, when they seek me with all their heart and with all their soul.

1:16 I will disclose to them abundance of peace with righteousness; I will remove them, the plant of righteousness, with all my heart and with all my soul; they will be for a blessing and not for a curse; they will be the head and not the tail.

1:17 I will build my sanctuary in their midst; I will dwell with them; I will be their Creator and they will be my people in truth and righteousness.

1:18 I will not abandon them nor fail them, for I am YHWH their Creator.

1:19 Moshe fell on his face and prayed and said: O YHWH my Creator, do not abandon your people and your inheritance, to wander in the error of their hearts; do not deliver them into the hand of their enemies, the nations, lest they rule over them and cause them to sin against you.

1:20 Let your mercy, O YHWH, be lifted up upon your people; create in them an upright spirit; let not the spirit of Beliyaal rule over them to accuse them before you; to ensnare them from every path of righteousness, that they may be destroyed from before your face.

1:21 But they are your people and your inheritance, which you have delivered with your great power from the hands of the Mitzriyim. Create in them a clean heart and a holy spirit; let them not be ensnared in their sins from that time onward.

1:22 YHWH said to Moshe: I know their contrariness; their thoughts; their stubbornness; they will not listen until they confess their own sin and the sin of their fathers.

1:23 after this they will turn to me in all uprightness and with all their heart and with all their soul; I will circumcise the foreskin of their heart and the foreskin of the heart of their seed; I will create in them a holy spirit; I will cleanse them so that they will not turn away from me from that day to eternity.

1:24 their souls will cleave to me and to all my commands; they will fulfill my commands; I will be their father and they will be my children.

1:25 they will all be called children of the living Creator; every angel and every spirit will know them; will know that they are my children; that I am their father in uprightness and righteousness; that I love them.

1:26 write down for yourself all these words which I declare to you on this mountain, the first and the last, which will happen in all the divisions of the days, in the law; in the testimony; in the weeks; in the jubilees, to eternity, until I descend and dwell with them throughout all the ages of eternity.

1:27 he said to the angel of the presence: Write for Moshe from the beginning of the creation until the time when my sanctuary will be built among them for all eternity.

1:28 YHWH will appear to the eyes of all; all will know that I am the Creator of Yisra'EL; the father of all the children of Yaakov; King on Mount Tziyon for all eternity; Tziyon and Yerushalayim will be holy.

1:29 the angel of the presence, who went before the camp of Yisra'EL, took the tablets of the divisions of the years, from the time of the creation, of the law and of the testimony, according to their weeks, according to the jubilees, year by year throughout the full number of jubilees, from the day of the new creation when the heaven and the earth will be renewed; all their creation, according to the powers of the heaven; according to all the creation of the earth, until the sanctuary of YHWH will be made in Yerushalayim on Mount Tziyon; all the lights of heaven be renewed for healing and for peace and for blessing for all the elect of Yisra'EL; that it may remain thus from that day to all the days of the earth.

TEXTUAL NOTES

[DSS] 4Q216 (4QJubᵃ) preserves 1:1–2, 1:4–15, 1:26–28 (DJD XIII, 1–22). Only surviving/readable material at the stated locus is treated as manuscript evidence; brackets, restored lacunae, and editorial retroversion are not treated as physically preserved Hebrew.

[ORIT GE'EZ] The continuous chapter sequence and content are checked against James C. VanderKam, The Book of Jubilees: A Critical Text / Translation (CSCO 510–511, 1989), based on the critical Ethiopic tradition. This reader does not claim a new diplomatic transcription of every individual Geʽez codex; Qumran Hebrew is applied only at extant loci.

[MASORETIC VARIANT] MT Exodus 24 supplies the Sinai ascent setting, but Jubilees 1 expands that setting into a long revelation about covenant breach, exile, restoration, and the angelic commission to write the history. Those extended prophetic and revelatory units have no continuous counterpart in the MT Sinai narrative and are comparison material only, not material imported from Exodus.

[CRITICAL NOTE] 4Q216 is an early Hebrew witness to substantial portions of Chapter 1. 4Q217 is not used here as an ordinary direct Jubilees witness because its identification and literary relationship remain debated; Tigchelaar treats the 4Q216/4Q217 evidence as relevant to possible literary growth.

CREATION AND THE FIRST JUBILEE — CHAPTERS 2 THROUGH 4

YOVELIM — CHAPTER 2 The Six Days of Creation — The Shabbat Covenant

2:1 the angel of the presence spoke to Moshe according to the word of YHWH, saying: Write the complete history of the creation - how in six days YHWH completed all his works and all that he created; kept Sabbath on the seventh day and made holy it for all ages; appointed it as a sign for all his works.

2:2 Because on the first day he created the heavens which are above and the earth and the waters and all the spirits which serve before him.

2:3 The angels of the presence; the angels of sanctification; the angels of the spirit of fire and the angels of the spirit of the winds; the angels of the spirit of the clouds; of darkness; of snow and of hail and of hoar frost; the angels of the voices and of the thunder and of the lightning; the angels of the spirits of cold and of heat; of winter and of spring and of autumn and of summer.

2:4 of all the spirits of his creatures which are in the heavens and on the earth he created the abysses and the darkness, eventide and night; the light, dawn and day, which he has prepared in the knowledge of his heart.

2:5 thereupon we saw his works; praised him; lauded before him on account of all his works - for seven great works did he create on the first day.

2:6 on the second day he created the firmament in the midst of the waters; the waters were divided on that day - half of them went up above and half of them went down below the firmament.

2:7 this was the only work that YHWH created on the second day.

2:8 on the third day he commanded the waters to pass from off the face of the whole earth into one place; the dry land to appear.

2:9 the waters did so as he commanded them; they retired from off the face of the earth into one place outside of this firmament; the dry land appeared.

2:10 on that day he created for them all the seas according to their separate gathering places; all the rivers; the gatherings of the waters in the mountains and on all the earth; all the lakes; all the dew of the earth.

2:11 the seed which is sown; all sprouting things; fruit-bearing trees; trees of the wood; the garden of Eden in Eden and all plants after their kind. These four great works YHWH created on the third day.

2:12 on the fourth day he created the sun and the moon and the stars; set them in the firmament of the heaven, to give light upon all the earth; to rule over the day and the night; divide the light from the darkness.

2:13 YHWH appointed the sun to be a great sign on the earth for days and for Sabbaths and for months and for feasts and for years and for Sabbaths of years and for jubilees and for all seasons of the years.

2:14 it divides the light from the darkness and for prosperity, that all things may prosper which shoot and grow on the earth.

2:15 These three kinds YHWH created on the fourth day.

2:16 on the fifth day he created great sea monsters in the depths of the waters; the fish and everything that moves in the waters; everything that flies - the birds and all their kind.

2:17 the sun rose above them to prosper them; above everything that was on the earth, everything that shoots out of the earth; all fruit-bearing trees; all flesh. These three kinds did he create on the fifth day.

2:18 on the sixth day he created all the animals of the earth; all cattle; everything that moves on the earth.

2:19 after all this he created man, a man and a woman created he them; gave him dominion over all that is on the earth; in the seas; over everything that flies; over beasts and over cattle; over everything that moves on the earth; over the whole earth; over all this he gave him dominion.

2:20 these four kinds he created on the sixth day. And there were altogether twenty-two kinds.

2:21 he finished all his work on the sixth day - all that is in the heavens and on the earth; in the seas and in the abysses; in the light and in the darkness; in everything.

2:22 he gave us a great sign, the Sabbath day, that we should work six days but keep Sabbath on the seventh day from all work.

2:23 all the angels of the presence; all the angels of sanctification, these two great classes - he has bidden us to keep the Sabbath with him in heaven and on earth.

2:24 YHWH said: I will separate to myself a people from among all the peoples; these will keep the Sabbath day; I will sanctify them to myself as my people; will bless them.

2:25 As I have sanctified the Sabbath day and do sanctify it to myself, even so will I bless them; they will be my people and I will be their Creator.

2:26 I have chosen the seed of Yaakov from amongst all that I have seen; have written him down as my firstborn son; have sanctified him to myself forever.

2:27 I will tell them of the Sabbath days, that they should keep Sabbath on it from all work.

2:28 thus he created in it a sign in accordance with which they should keep Sabbath with us on the seventh day, to eat and to drink; to bless him who has created all things as he has blessed and sanctified to himself a people set apart above all peoples; that they should keep Sabbath together with us.

2:29 Declare and command the children of Yisra'EL the law of this day, both that they should keep Sabbath on it; that they should not abandon it in the error of their hearts; that it is not lawful to do any work on it which is unseemly, to do on it their own pleasure; that they should not prepare on it anything to be eaten or drunk; that it is not lawful to draw water, or bring in or take out on it through their gates any burden which they had not prepared for themselves on the sixth day in their dwellings.

2:30 they will not bring in nor take out from house to house on that day, for that day is more holy and blessed than any jubilee day of the jubilees. On this day we kept Sabbath in the heavens before it was made known to any flesh to keep Sabbath on it on the earth.

2:31 the Creator of all things blessed it, but he did not sanctify all peoples and nations to keep Sabbath on it, but Yisra'EL alone. Them alone he permitted to eat and drink and to keep Sabbath on it on the earth.

2:32 the Creator of all things blessed this day which he had created for blessing and holiness and glory above all days. This law and testimony was given to the children of Yisra'EL as a law for ever to their generations.

2:33 he caused his commands to ascend as a sweet savor acceptable before him all the days, an eternal witness ordained and written on the heavenly tablets concerning the sons of Yisra'EL, that they should celebrate the Sabbath with him on the seventh day, to eat and drink and bless the Creator of all things, as he has blessed and sanctified to himself a people set apart above all peoples of the earth.

TEXTUAL NOTES

[DSS] 4Q216 (4QJubᵃ) preserves 2:1–4, 2:7–24 (DJD XIII, 1–22). 4Q218 (4QJubᶜ) preserves 2:26–27 (DJD XIII, 35–38). Only surviving/readable material at the stated locus is treated as manuscript evidence; brackets, restored lacunae, and editorial retroversion are not treated as physically preserved Hebrew.

[ORIT GE'EZ] The continuous chapter sequence and content are checked against James C. VanderKam, The Book of Jubilees: A Critical Text / Translation (CSCO 510–511, 1989), based on the critical Ethiopic tradition. This reader does not claim a new diplomatic transcription of every individual Geʽez codex; Qumran Hebrew is applied only at extant loci.

[MASORETIC VARIANT] MT Genesis 1:1-2:3 is the principal narrative comparison. Jubilees 2 reorganizes and expands the creation account, includes created angelic orders and other works not enumerated in MT Genesis 1, and greatly enlarges the Sabbath material beyond Genesis 2:1-3.

[CRITICAL NOTE] 4Q216 and 4Q218 provide direct Hebrew controls at the listed loci. Variant wording, word order, and lacuna restoration are treated locally; they do not authorize replacing the continuous chapter with reconstructed Hebrew.

YOVELIM — CHAPTER 3 Adam and Chavah in the Garden — The Fall and the Garments

3:1 on the sixth day of the second week we brought to Adam, on YHWH's command, all the animals, all the cattle, all the birds; everything that moves on the earth and everything that moves in the water, according to their kinds - the animals on the first day, the cattle on the second day, the birds on the third day, everything that moves on the earth on the fourth day; that which moves in the water on the fifth day.

3:2 Adam named them all, each by its own name; whatever he called them became their name.

3:3 during these five days Adam looked at all these - male and female - among every kind that was on the earth, but he himself was alone; there was none whom he found for himself who could be a helper corresponding to him.

3:4 YHWH said to us: It is not good that man should be alone. Let us make him a helper corresponding to him.

3:5 YHWH our Creator caused a deep sleep to fall upon him; he slept; he took a bone from among his bones for a woman; that bone was the origin of the woman, from among his bones. And he built up the flesh in its stead; built the woman.

3:6 he awoke Adam out of his sleep; on awaking he rose on the sixth day; he brought her to him; he knew her; told her: This is now bone of my bone and flesh of my flesh. This one will be called my wife, because she was taken from her husband.

3:7 Because this reason will a man and a woman be one; for this reason will he leave his father and mother and cleave to his wife; they will become one flesh.

3:8 In the first week Adam and his wife were created - that is, the rib - and in the second week he showed her to him; for this reason the commandment was given to observe seven days for a male; for a female twice seven days, in their impurity.

3:9 after Adam had completed forty days in the land where he had been created, we brought him into the garden of Eden to till and keep it, but his wife they brought in on the eightieth day; after this she entered into the garden of Eden.

3:10 Because this reason the commandment is written on the heavenly tablets touching her that gives birth: If she bears a male, she will remain in her uncleanness seven days according to the first seven days; thirty-three days will she remain in the blood of her purifying; she will not touch any made holy thing, nor enter into the sanctuary until she has completed these days for a male.

3:11 as for a female she will remain in her uncleanness two weeks of days, according to the first two weeks; sixty-six days in the blood of her purification; they will be in all eighty days.

3:12 when she had completed these eighty days we brought her into the garden of Eden, for it is holier than all the earth besides; every tree that is planted in it is holy.

3:13 Because this reason there is ordained regarding her who bears a male or female the law of these days, that she should touch no made holy thing, nor enter into the sanctuary until these days are accomplished for a male or a female.

3:14 This is the law and testimony which was written down for Yisra'EL, that they should observe it all the days.

3:15 in the first week of the first jubilee Adam and his wife were in the garden of Eden seven years, tilling and keeping it; we gave him work; we instructed him to do everything that was fitting for tillage.

3:16 he tilled the garden; was naked; knew it not; was not ashamed; he protected the garden from birds and beasts and cattle; gathered its fruit; ate; put aside the residue for himself and his wife; put aside what was being kept.

3:17 after the completion of the seven years, which he had completed there, seven years exactly; in the second month, on the seventeenth day, the serpent came and approached the woman.

3:18 the serpent said to the woman: Has YHWH truly commanded you not to eat of every tree of the garden?

3:19 she told him: Of the fruit of the trees of the garden YHWH has said to us: Eat; but of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, YHWH has said to us: You will not eat of it, neither will you touch it, lest you die.

3:20 the serpent said to the woman: You will not surely die, for YHWH knows that on the day you eat of it, your eyes will be opened; you will be like gods; you will know good and evil.

3:21 the woman saw the tree that it was agreeable and pleasant to the eye; its fruit was good for food; she took of it and ate.

3:22 she first covered her shame with fig leaves; then she gave to Adam and he ate; his eyes were opened; he saw that he was naked.

3:23 he took fig leaves and sewed them together and made an apron for himself and covered his shame.

3:24 YHWH cursed the serpent and was angry with it forever.

3:25 he was angry also with the woman, because she listened to the voice of the serpent and ate. And he told her: I will greatly multiply your sorrow and your pains. In sorrow you will bring forth children; your return will be to your husband; he will rule over you.

3:26 to Adam also he said: Because you have listened to the voice of your wife; have eaten of the tree concerning which I commanded you that you should not eat of it, cursed be the ground for your sake. Thorns and thistles will it bring forth for you; you will eat your bread in the sweat of your face, until you return to the earth from which you were taken, for earth you are; to earth will you return.

3:27 he made for them coats of skin; clothed them; sent them forth from the garden of Eden.

3:28 on the day that Adam went forth from the garden of Eden, he offered as a sweet savor an offering - frankincense, galbanum; stacte; spices - in the morning with the rising of the sun, from the day when he covered his shame.

3:29 on that day was closed the mouth of all beasts; of cattle; of birds; of whatever walks; of whatever moves, so that they could no longer speak, for they had all spoken with one another with one lip and with one tongue.

3:30 he sent out of the garden of Eden all flesh that was in the garden of Eden; all flesh was scattered according to its kinds; according to its type, to the places which had been created for them.

3:31 to Adam alone did he give the wherewithal to cover his shame, of all the beasts and cattle.

3:32 On this account it is prescribed on the heavenly tablets, as touching all those who know the judgment of the law, that they should cover their shame; should not uncover themselves as the nations uncover themselves.

3:33 on the new moon of the fourth month, Adam and his wife went forth from the garden of Eden; they lived in the land of Elda, in the land of their creation.

3:34 Adam called the name of his wife Havah.

3:35 they had no son until the first jubilee; after this he knew her. Now he tilled the land as he had been instructed in the garden of Eden.

TEXTUAL NOTES

[DSS] No securely mapped Qumran Jubilees locus is asserted as a direct Hebrew control for this chapter in this reader.

[ORIT GE'EZ] The continuous chapter sequence and content are checked against James C. VanderKam, The Book of Jubilees: A Critical Text / Translation (CSCO 510–511, 1989), based on the critical Ethiopic tradition. This reader does not claim a new diplomatic transcription of every individual Geʽez codex; Qumran Hebrew is applied only at extant loci.

[MASORETIC VARIANT] MT Genesis 2:18-3:24, with Genesis 4:1, provides the principal comparison. Jubilees treats the material as a continuous sequence after the six-day creation and adds chronological and legal framing not present in the MT account.

[CRITICAL NOTE] Chapter 3 is not merely a retelling of Eden. The continuous Ethiopic text integrates chronological notices and purity-related interpretation into the Adam-and-Havah sequence. Those additions must remain distinct from Genesis-derived wording when the chapter is reconstructed.

YOVELIM — CHAPTER 4 The Genealogy from Adam to Noakh — Chanokh's Translation

4:1 in the third week in the second jubilee she gave birth to Kayin; in the fourth she gave birth to Hevel; in the fifth she gave birth to his daughter Avan.

4:2 in the first year of the third jubilee, Kayin slew Hevel because YHWH accepted the sacrifice of Hevel; did not accept the offering of Kayin.

4:3 he slew him in the field; his blood cried from the ground to heaven, complaining because he had slain him.

4:4 YHWH reproved Kayin because of Hevel, because he had slain him; he made him a fugitive on the earth because of the blood of his brother; he cursed him upon the earth.

4:5 on this account it is written on the heavenly tablets: Cursed is he who smites his neighbor treacherously; let all who have seen and heard say: So be it. And the man who has seen and not declared it, let him be accursed as the one who committed it.

4:6 for this reason we announce when we come before YHWH our Creator all the sin which is committed in heaven and on earth; in light and in darkness; everywhere.

4:7 Adam and his wife mourned for Hevel four weeks of years; in the fourth year of the fifth week they became joyful; Adam knew his wife again; she bore him a son; he called his name Shet - for he said: YHWH has raised up a second seed to us on the earth instead of Hevel, for Kayin slew him.

4:8 in the sixth week he fathered his daughter Azura.

4:9 Kayin took Avan his sister to be his wife; she bore him Khanokh at the close of the fourth jubilee.

4:10 in the first year of the first week of the fifth jubilee, houses were built on the earth; Kayin built a city; called its name after the name of his son Khanokh.

4:11 Adam knew Eve his wife and she bore yet nine sons.

4:12 in the fifth week of the fifth jubilee Shet took Azura his sister to be his wife; in the fourth year of the sixth week she bore him Enosh.

4:13 He began to call on the name of YHWH on the earth.

4:14 in the seventh jubilee in the third week Enosh took Noam his sister to be his wife; she bore him a son in the third year of the fifth week; he called his name Kenan.

4:15 at the close of the eighth jubilee Kenan took Mualeleth his sister to be his wife; she bore him a son in the ninth jubilee, in the first week in the third year of this week; he called his name Mahalalel.

4:16 in the second week of the tenth jubilee Mahalalel took to him to wife Dinah, the daughter of Barakiel the daughter of his father's brother; she bore him a son in the third week in the sixth year; he called his name Yered - for in his days the angels of YHWH descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers, that they should instruct the children of men; that they should do judgment and uprightness on the earth.

4:17 in the eleventh jubilee Yered took to himself a wife; her name was Baraka, the daughter of Rasujal, a daughter of his father's brother, in the fourth week of this jubilee; she bore him a son in the fifth week, in the fourth year of the jubilee; he called his name Chanokh.

4:18 he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven according to the order of their months in a book, that men might know the seasons of the years according to the order of their separate months.

4:19 he was the first to write a testimony and he testified to the sons of men among the generations of the earth; recounted the weeks of the jubilees; made known to them the days of the years; set in order the months and recounted the Sabbaths of the years as we made them known to him.

4:20 what was and what will be he saw in a vision of his sleep, as it will happen to the children of men throughout their generations until the day of judgment - he saw and understood everything; wrote his testimony; placed the testimony on earth for all the children of men and for their generations.

4:21 in the twelfth jubilee, in the seventh week of it, he took to himself a wife; her name was Edni, the daughter of Danel, the daughter of his father's brother; in the sixth year in this week she bore him a son and he called his name Metushelakh.

4:22 he was moreover with the angels of YHWH these six jubilees of years; they showed him everything which is on earth and in the heavens, the rule of the sun; he wrote down everything.

4:23 he testified to the Watchers, who had sinned with the daughters of men - for these had begun to unite themselves, so as to be defiled, with the daughters of men; Chanokh testified against them all.

4:24 he was taken from amongst the children of men; we conducted him into the Garden of Eden in majesty and honor; there he writes down the condemnation and judgment of the world; all the wickedness of the children of men.

4:25 on account of it YHWH brought the waters of the flood upon all the land of Eden - for there he was set as a sign and that he should testify against all the children of men, that he should recount all the deeds of the generations until the day of condemnation.

4:26 he burnt the incense of the sanctuary, even sweet spices, acceptable before YHWH on the Mount.

4:27 Because YHWH has four places on the earth - the Garden of Eden; the Mount of the East; this mountain on which you are this day, Mount Sinai; Mount Tziyon which will be sanctified in the new creation for a sanctification of the earth - through it will the earth be sanctified from all its guilt and its uncleanness throughout the generations of the world.

4:28 in the fourteenth jubilee Metushelakh took to himself a wife, Edna the daughter of Azrial, the daughter of his mother's brother, in the third week, in the first year of this week; he fathered a son and called his name Lamekh.

4:29 in the fifteenth jubilee in the third week Lamekh took to himself a wife; her name was Betenos the daughter of Barakiel, the daughter of his father's brother; in this week she bore him a son; he called his name Noakh, saying: This one will comfort me for my trouble and all my work; for the ground which YHWH has cursed.

4:30 at the close of the nineteenth jubilee, in the seventh week in the sixth year of it, Adam died; all his sons buried him in the land of his creation; he was the first to be buried in the earth.

4:31 he lacked seventy years of one thousand years - for one thousand years are as one day in the testimony of the heavens; therefore was it written concerning the tree of knowledge: On the day that you eat of it you will die. For this reason he did not complete the years of this day - for he died during it.

4:32 At the close of this jubilee Kayin was killed after him in the same year - for his house fell upon him and he died in the midst of his house; he was killed by its stones - for with a stone he had killed Hevel; by a stone was he killed in righteous judgment.

4:33 Because this reason it was ordained on the heavenly tablets: With the instrument with which a man kills his neighbor with the same will he be killed - after the manner that he wounded him, in like manner will they deal with him.

YOVELIM — CHAPTER 5 The Watchers and the Flood — The Covenant with Noakh

5:1 It happened when the children of men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them, that the angels of YHWH saw them on a certain year of this jubilee, that they were beautiful to look upon; they took themselves wives of all whom they chose; they bore to them sons and they were giants.

5:2 lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way, alike men and cattle and beasts and birds and everything that walks on the earth - all of them corrupted their ways and their orders; they began to devour each other; lawlessness increased on the earth and every imagination of the thoughts of all men was thus evil continually.

5:3 YHWH looked upon the earth; it was corrupt; all flesh had corrupted its orders; all that were upon the earth had done all manner of evil before his eyes.

5:4 he said that he would destroy man and all flesh upon the face of the earth which he had created.

5:5 But Noakh found grace before the eyes of YHWH.

5:6 against the angels whom he had sent upon the earth, he was exceedingly angry; he gave commandment to root them out of all their dominion; he bade us to bind them in the depths of the earth; they are bound in the midst of them; are kept separate.

5:7 against their sons went forth a command from before his face that they should be smitten with the sword; be removed from under heaven.

5:8 he said: My spirit will not always abide on man - for they also are flesh and their days will be one hundred and twenty years.

5:9 he sent his sword into their midst that each should kill his neighbor; they began to kill each other till they all fell by the sword and were destroyed from the earth.

5:10 their fathers were witnesses of their destruction; after this they were bound in the depths of the earth forever, until the day of the great condemnation, when judgment is executed on all those who have corrupted their ways and their works before YHWH.

5:11 he destroyed all from their places; there was not left one of them whom he judged not according to all their wickedness.

5:12 he made for all his works a new and righteous nature, so that they should not sin in their whole nature forever, but should be all righteous each in his kind always.

5:13 the judgment of all is ordained and written on the heavenly tablets in righteousness - even the judgment of all who depart from the path which is ordained for them to walk in - and if they walk not in it, judgment is written down for every creature and for every kind.

5:14 there is nothing in heaven or on earth, or in light or in darkness, or in Sheol or in the depth, or in the place of darkness, which is not judged - all their judgments are ordained and written and engraved.

5:15 In regard to all he will judge, the great according to his greatness; the small according to his smallness; each according to his way.

5:16 he is not one who will regard the person of any, nor is he one who will receive gifts, if he says that he will execute judgment on each - on all whether it be the small or great, whether it be the angels or man - and there is no wisdom that can change his purpose.

5:17 Because he has created all things; he knows all things; his power is over all their judgments.

5:18 he will judge in righteousness; there will be peace for all the righteous before him; he will not be partial to any; there will be no acceptance of persons for him - for he is their Creator.

5:19 in those days Noakh saw the earth that it had become corrupted; all flesh had corrupted its orders; all that were upon the earth had done all manner of evil before his eyes.

5:20 he saw that blood was shed on the earth; that all men had become evil and were eating flesh with blood; that every imagination of the evil thoughts of their hearts was only evil all the time.

5:21 YHWH said to Noakh: Make you an ark of wood - cypress wood - and cover it inside and outside with pitch and make it three hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide and thirty cubits high.

5:22 Noakh said to YHWH: I will do all that you commandest me.

5:23 YHWH said to Noakh: You; your sons; your wife; your sons' wives will enter into the ark - from all flesh that is on the earth you will take, two of each kind into the ark to keep them alive.

5:24 Noakh made the ark in all respects as YHWH had commanded him, in the twenty-seventh jubilee of years, in the fifth week in the fifth year of it.

5:25 he entered in the sixth year of it, in the second month, on the new moon of the second month, till the sixteenth - he and all that we brought to him, into the ark; YHWH closed it from without on the seventeenth evening.

5:26 YHWH opened seven flood-gates of heaven; the mouths of the fountains of the great deep, seven mouths in number.

5:27 the flood-gates began to pour down water from the heaven forty days and forty nights; the fountains of the deep also sent up waters, until the whole world was full of water.

5:28 the waters increased upon the face of the earth - fifteen cubits did the waters rise above all the high mountains - and the ark was lift up above the earth; it moved upon the face of the waters.

5:29 the water prevailed on the face of the earth five months - one hundred and fifty days.

5:30 the ark went and rested on the top of Lubar, one of the mountains of Ararat.

5:31 on the new moon in the fourth month the fountains of the great deep were closed and the flood-gates of heaven were restrained; on the new moon of the seventh month all the mouths of the abysses of the earth were opened; the water began to descend into the deep below.

5:32 on the new moon of the tenth month the tops of the mountains were seen; Noakh was glad.

YOVELIM — CHAPTER 6 Noakh's Covenant — The Festival of Shavuot — The Solar Calendar Command

6:1 On the new moon of the third month, Noakh left the ark and built an altar on the mountain.

6:2 He took a young goat and made atonement with its blood for the land, because everything on the earth had been destroyed except those who were in the ark with Noakh.

6:3 he placed the fat of it on the altar; he took an ox; a goat; a sheep and kids; salt; a turtle-dove; the morning dove; placed a burnt offering on the altar; poured on it an offering mingled with oil; sprinkled wine and strewed frankincense over everything; caused a pleasing aroma to arise, acceptable before YHWH.

6:4 YHWH smelled the pleasing aroma; he made a covenant with him that there should not be any more floods to destroy the earth - that all the days of the earth seed-time and harvest should never cease - cold and heat; summer and winter; day and night should not change their order, nor cease forever.

6:5 you, increase you and multiply upon the earth; become many upon it; be a blessing upon it. The fear of you and the dread of you I will inspire in everything that is on earth and in the sea.

6:6 I have given to you all beasts; all winged things; everything that moves on the earth; the fish in the waters; all things for food - as the green herbs, I have given you all things to eat.

6:7 But flesh, with the life of it, with the blood, you will not eat - for the life of all flesh is in the blood, lest your blood of your lives be required. At the hand of every man, at the hand of every beast, will I require the blood of man.

6:8 Whoever sheds man's blood, by man will his blood be shed - for in the image of YHWH made he man.

6:9 you, increase and multiply on the earth.

6:10 Noakh and his sons swore that they would not eat any blood that was in any flesh; he made a covenant before YHWH forever throughout all the generations of the earth in this month.

6:11 On this account he spoke to you that you should make a covenant with the children of Yisra'EL in this month upon the mountain with an oath; that you should sprinkle blood upon them because of all the words of the covenant, which YHWH made with them forever.

6:12 this testimony is written concerning you that you should observe it continually, so that you should not eat on any day any blood of beasts or birds or cattle during all the days of the earth; the man who eats the blood of beast or of cattle or of birds during all the days of the earth, he and his seed will be rooted out of the land.

6:13 do you command the children of Yisra'EL to eat no blood, so that their names and their seed may be before YHWH our Creator continually.

6:14 for this law there is no limit of days, for it is forever. They will observe it throughout their generations, so that they may continue suppliating on your behalf before YHWH your Creator continually.

6:15 after this sacrifice Noakh gave thanks and praised YHWH who had delivered him and his sons from the waters of the flood.

6:16 he gave to them a sign; he placed the bow in the cloud for a sign of the eternal covenant that there should not again be water for a flood on the earth to destroy it all the days of the earth.

6:17 Because this reason it is ordained and written on the heavenly tablets, that they should celebrate the feast of weeks in this month once a year, to renew the covenant every year.

6:18 this whole festival was celebrated in heaven from the day of creation till the days of Noakh - twenty-six jubilees and five weeks of years - and Noakh and his sons observed it for seven jubilees and one week of years, till the day of Noakh's death; from the day of Noakh's death his sons did away with it until the days of Avraham; they ate blood.

6:19 But Avraham observed it; Yitzhak and Yaakov and his children observed it up to your days; in your days the children of Yisra'EL forgot it until you celebrated it anew on this mountain.

6:20 do you command the children of Yisra'EL to observe this festival in all their generations for a commandment to them - one day in the year in this month they will celebrate the festival.

6:21 Because it is the feast of weeks and the feast of firstfruits - this feast is twofold and of a double nature - according as it is written and engraved concerning it, celebrate it.

6:22 Because I have written in the book of the first law, in that which I have written for you, that you should celebrate it in its season, one day in the year; I explained to you its sacrifices that the children of Yisra'EL should remember and should celebrate it throughout their generations in this month, one day every year.

6:23 on the new moon of the first month; on the new moon of the fourth month; on the new moon of the seventh month; on the new moon of the tenth month are the days of remembrance; the days of the seasons in the four divisions of the year. These are written and ordained as a testimony forever.

6:24 Noakh ordained them for himself as feasts for the generations forever, so that they have become thereby a memorial to him.

6:25 on the new moon of the first month he was bidden to make for himself an ark; on that day the earth became dry and he opened the ark and saw the earth.

6:26 on the new moon of the fourth month the mouths of the depths of the abyss beneath were closed. And on the new moon of the seventh month all the mouths of the abysses of the earth were opened; the waters began to descend into them.

6:27 on the new moon of the tenth month the tops of the mountains were seen; Noakh was glad.

6:28 on this account he ordained them for himself as feasts for a memorial forever; thus are they ordained.

6:29 they placed them on the heavenly tablets - each had thirteen weeks - from one to another passed their memorial, from the first to the second; from the second to the third; from the third to the fourth.

6:30 all the days of the commandment will be two and fifty weeks of days; these will make the entire year complete. Thus it is engraved and ordained on the heavenly tablets.

6:31 there is no neglecting this commandment for a single year or from year to year.

6:32 do you command you the children of Yisra'EL that they observe the years according to this reckoning - three hundred and sixty-four days - and these will constitute a complete year; they will not disturb its time from its days and from its feasts - for everything will fall out in them according to their testimony; they will not leave out any day nor disturb any feasts.

6:33 But if they do neglect and do not observe them according to his commandment, then they will disturb all their seasons and the years will be dislodged from this order; they will neglect their statutes.

6:34 all the children of Yisra'EL will forget and will not find the path of the years; will forget the new moons; seasons; Sabbaths - and they will go wrong as to all the order of the years.

6:35 Because I know and from this time will I declare it to you; it is not of my own devising - for the book lies written before me; on the heavenly tablets the division of days is ordained, lest they forget the feasts of the covenant and walk according to the feasts of the Gentiles after their error and after their ignorance.

6:36 Because there will be those who will assuredly make observations of the moon - how it disturbs the seasons and comes in from year to year ten days too soon.

6:37 Because this reason the years will come upon them when they will disturb the order; make an abominable day the day of testimony; an unclean day a feast day; they will confound all the days, the holy with the unclean; the unclean day with the holy - for they will go wrong as to the months and Sabbaths and feasts and jubilees.

6:38 Because this reason I command and testify to you that you may testify to them - for after your death your children will disturb them, so that they will not make the year three hundred and sixty-four days only; for this reason they will go wrong as to the new moons and seasons and Sabbaths and festivals; they will eat all kinds of blood with all kinds of flesh.

YOVELIM — CHAPTER 7 Noakh's Wine — The Division of the Earth Among the Sons

7:1 in the seventh week, in the first year of it, in this jubilee, Noakh planted vines on the mountain on which the ark had rested, named Lubar, one of the mountains of Ararat; they produced fruit in the fourth year; he guarded their fruit and gathered it in that year, in the seventh month.

7:2 he made wine from it and put it into a vessel; kept it until the fifth year, until the first day, on the new moon of the first month.

7:3 he celebrated with joy the day of this feast; he made a burnt offering to YHWH - one young ox and one ram; seven sheep, each a year old; a kid of the goats - that he might make atonement thereby for himself and his sons.

7:4 he prepared the kid first; placed some of its blood on the flesh that was on the altar which he had made; all the fat he laid on the altar where he made the burnt offering; the ox and the ram and the sheep; he laid all their flesh upon the altar.

7:5 he placed all their offerings mingled with oil upon it; afterwards he sprinkled wine on the fire which he had previously made on the altar; he placed incense on the altar and caused a sweet savor to ascend, acceptable before YHWH his Creator.

7:6 he rejoiced and drank of this wine, he and his children, with joy.

7:7 it was evening; he went into his tent; being drunken he lay down and slept; was uncovered in his tent as he slept.

7:8 Kham saw Noakh his father naked; went forth and told his two brothers outside.

7:9 Shem took his garment and arose, he and Yafet; they walked backwards and covered the shame of their father; their faces were backwards.

7:10 Noakh awoke from his sleep and knew all that his youngest son had done to him; he cursed his son and said: Cursed be Kena'an - may he become an abject slave to his brothers.

7:11 Noakh then blessed Shem, saying: Blessed be YHWH, the Creator of Shem; may Kena'an become his servant.

7:12 He blessed Yafet also: May YHWH enlarge Yafet; may he dwell where Shem dwells; may Kena'an become his servant.

7:13 Kham knew that his father had cursed his youngest son; he was displeased that he had cursed his son; he parted from his father - he and his sons with him - Kush and Mitzrayim and Put and Kena'an.

7:14 he built for himself a city and called its name after the name of his wife Ne'elatama'uk.

7:15 Yafet saw it; became envious of his brother; he too built for himself a city; called its name after the name of his wife Adataneses.

7:16 Shem lived with his father Noakh; he built a city close to his father on the mountain; he too called its name after the name of his wife Sedeqetelebab.

7:17 these three cities are near Mount Lubar - Sedeqetelebab fronting the mountain on its east, Ne'elatama'uk on the south, Adataneses towards the west.

7:18 these are the sons of Shem: Elam; Ashur; Arpakhshad - this son was born two years after the flood - and Lud; Aram.

7:19 The sons of Yafet: Gomer and Magog and Madai and Yavan, Tuval and Meshekh and Tiras. These are the sons of Noakh.

7:20 in the twenty-eighth jubilee Noakh began to enjoin upon his sons' sons the statutes and commands; all the judgments that he knew; he exhorted his sons to observe righteousness; to cover the shame of their flesh; to bless their Creator; honor father and mother; love their neighbor; guard their souls from fornication and uncleanness and all iniquity.

7:21 Because owing to these three things came the flood upon the earth - namely, owing to the fornication in which the Watchers, against the law of their statutes, went whoring after the daughters of men and took to themselves wives of all whom they chose; made the beginning of uncleanness.

7:22 they begot sons, the Nephilim; they were all unlike; they devoured one another - the giant slew the Naphil; the Naphil slew the Elyo; the Elyo mankind; one man another.

7:23 everyone sold himself to work iniquity and to shed much blood; the earth was filled with iniquity.

7:24 after this they sinned against the beasts and birds; all that moves and walks on the earth; much blood was shed on the earth; every imagination and desire of men imagined vanity and evil continually.

7:25 YHWH destroyed everything from off the face of the earth. Because of the wickedness of their deeds; because of the blood which they had shed in the midst of the earth, he destroyed everything.

7:26 we were left, I and you, my sons; all that came with us; I see your deeds before me, that you do not walk in righteousness, for in the path of destruction you have begun to walk; you are parting one from another; are envious one of another; are not, my sons, in harmony one with another.

7:27 Because I see; the demons have begun their seductions against you and your children; now I fear on your behalf that after my death you will shed the blood of men upon the earth; that you, too, will be destroyed from the face of the earth.

7:28 Because whoever sheds man's blood; whoever eats the blood of any flesh, will all be destroyed from the earth.

7:29 there will not be left any man that eats blood, or that sheds the blood of man on the earth, nor will there be left to him any seed or descendant living under heaven, for into Sheol will they go; into the place of condemnation will they descend; into the darkness of the deep will they all be removed by a violent death.

7:30 There will be no blood seen upon you of all the blood there will be during all the days in which you have killed any beasts or cattle or whatever flies upon the earth; take pleasure in doing a good deed to your souls by covering that which has been shed on the face of the earth.

7:31 you will not be like him who eats with blood, but guard yourselves that none may eat blood before you. Cover the blood, for so I have been commanded to testify to you and your children, together with all flesh.

7:32 do not permit the soul to be eaten with the flesh, that your blood, which is your life, may not be required at the hand of any flesh that sheds it on the earth.

7:33 Because the earth will not be clean from the blood which has been shed upon it, but through the blood of him that shed it will the earth be purified in all its generations.

7:34 now, my children, listen - work judgment and righteousness that you may be planted in righteousness over the face of the whole earth; your glory lifted up before my Creator, who saved me from the waters of the flood.

7:35 you will go and build for yourselves cities; plant in them all the plants which are upon the earth; moreover all fruit-bearing trees.

7:36 Because three years the fruit of everything that is eaten will not be gathered; in the fourth year its fruit will be accounted holy; they will offer the firstfruits, acceptable before YHWH Most High, who created heaven and earth and everything, that they may offer in abundance the firstfruits of the wine and oil as first-fruits on the altar of YHWH, who receives it; what is left the servants of the house of YHWH will eat before the altar which receives it.

7:37 in the fifth year make you a release, so that you release it in righteousness and uprightness; you will be righteous; all your plants will prosper.

7:38 Because thus did Chanokh, the father of your father, command Metushelakh his son; Metushelakh his son Lamekh; Lamekh commanded me all the things which his fathers commanded him.

7:39 I also will give you commandment, my sons, as Chanokh commanded his son in the first jubilees. While yet living, the seventh in his generation, he commanded and testified to his son and to his son's sons until the day of his death.

24:11 in your seed will all the nations of the earth be blessed, because your father obeyed my voice; kept my charge and my commands; my laws; my statutes; my covenant. And now obey my voice and dwell in this land.

24:12 he lived in Gerar three weeks of years.

24:13 Avimelekh charged concerning him; concerning all that was his, saying: Any man that will touch him or anything of his will surely die.

24:14 Yitzhak grew strong among the Pelishtim; he got many possessions - oxen and sheep and camels and donkeys and a great household.

24:15 he sowed in the land of the Pelishtim and brought in a hundredfold; Yitzhak became exceedingly great; the Pelishtim envied him.

24:16 Now all the wells which the servants of Avraham had dug during the life of Avraham, the Pelishtim had stopped them after the death of Avraham; filled them with earth.

24:17 Avimelekh said to Yitzhak: Go from us, for you are much mightier than we. And Yitzhak departed from there in the first year of the seventh week; sojourned in the valleys of Gerar.

24:18 they dug again the wells of water which the servants of Avraham, his father, had dug; which the Pelishtim had closed after the death of Avraham his father; he called their names as Avraham his father had named them.

24:19 the servants of Yitzhak dug a well in the valley; found living water; the shepherds of Gerar strove with the shepherds of Yitzhak, saying: The water is ours. And Yitzhak called the name of the well Contention, because they had been contentious with us.

24:20 they dug a second well; they strove for that also; he called its name Enmity. And he arose from there and they dug another well; for that they strove not; he called its name Room; Yitzhak said: Now YHWH has made room for us; we have increased in the land.

24:21 he went up from there to the well of the oath in the first year of the first week in the forty-fourth jubilee.

24:22 YHWH appeared to him that night, on the new moon of the first month; told him: I am the Creator of Avraham your father. Fear not, for I am with you; will bless you and will surely multiply your seed as the sand of the earth, for the sake of Avraham my servant.

24:23 he built an altar there, which Avraham his father had first built; he called upon the name of YHWH; he offered sacrifice to the Creator of Avraham his father.

24:24 they dug a well and found living water.

24:25 the servants of Yitzhak dug another well and did not find water; they went and told Yitzhak that they had not found water; Yitzhak said: I have sworn this day to the Pelishtim and this thing has been announced to us.

24:26 he called the name of that place the well of the oath, for there he had sworn to Avimelekh and Achuzzat his friend and Pikhol the prefect of his host.

24:27 Yitzhak knew that day that under constraint he had sworn to them to make peace with them.

24:28 Yitzhak on that day cursed the Pelishtim and said: Cursed be the Pelishtim to the day of wrath and indignation from the midst of all nations. May YHWH make them a derision and a curse and an object of wrath and indignation in the hands of the sinners the nations and in the hands of the Kittim.

24:29 whoever escapes the sword of the enemy and the Kittim, may the righteous nation root out in judgment from under heaven, for they will be the enemies and foes of my children throughout their generations upon the earth.

24:30 no remnant will be left to them, nor one that will be saved on the day of the wrath of judgment, for destruction and rooting out and expulsion from the earth is the whole seed of the Pelishtim; there will no longer be left for these Kaftorim a name or a seed on the earth.

24:31 Because though he ascend to heaven, from there will he be brought down; though he make himself strong on earth, from there will he be dragged forth; though he hide himself among the nations, even from there will he be rooted out; though he descend into Sheol, there also will his condemnation be great; there also he will have no peace.

24:32 if he go into captivity, by the hands of those that seek his life will they kill him on the way; neither name nor seed will be left to him on all the earth, for into eternal malediction will he depart.

24:33 thus is it written and engraved concerning him on the heavenly tablets, to do to him on the day of judgment, so that he may be rooted out of the earth.

YOVELIM — CHAPTER 25 Yaakov Refuses the Daughters of Kena'an — The Bethel Dream

25:1 in the second year of this week in this jubilee, Rivkah called Yaakov her son; spoke to him, saying: My son, do not take a wife of the daughters of Kena'an, as Esav your brother, who took two wives of the daughters of Kena'an; they have embittered my soul with all their unclean deeds, for all their deeds are fornication and lust; there is no righteousness with them, for their deeds are evil.

25:2 I, my son, love you exceedingly; my heart and my affection bless you every hour of the day and watch of the night.

25:3 now, my son, listen to my voice; do the will of your mother; do not take a wife of the daughters of this land, but only of the house of my father; of my father's kindred. You will take a wife of the house of my father; the Most High Creator will bless you; your children will be a righteous generation and a holy seed.

25:4 then Yaakov spoke to Rivkah his mother; told her: mother, I am nine weeks of years old; I neither know nor have I touched any woman, nor have I betrothed myself to any, nor even think of taking a wife of the daughters of Kena'an.

25:5 Because I remember, mother, the words of Avraham our father, for he commanded me not to take a wife of the daughters of Kena'an, but to take a wife from the seed of my father's house and from my kindred.

25:6 I have heard before that daughters have been born to Lavan your brother; I have set my heart on them to take a wife from among them.

25:7 for this reason I have guarded myself in my spirit against sinning or being corrupted in all my ways throughout throughout my life, for with regard to lust and fornication, Avraham my father gave me many commands.

25:8 despite all that he has commanded me, these two and twenty years my brother has striven with me; spoken frequently to me and said: My brother, take to wife a sister of my two wives. But I refuse to do as he has done.

25:9 I swear before you, mother, that throughout my life I will not take a wife from the daughters of the seed of Kena'an; I will not act wickedly as my brother has done.

25:10 Fear not, mother. Be assured that I will do your will and walk in uprightness; not corrupt my ways forever.

25:11 thereupon she lifted up her face to heaven; extended the fingers of her hands; opened her mouth and blessed the Most High Creator, who had created the heaven and the earth; she gave him thanks and praise.

25:12 she said: Blessed be YHWH; may his holy name be blessed forever and ever, who has given me Yaakov as a pure son and a holy seed, for he is yours; yours will his seed be continually and throughout all the generations forevermore.

25:13 Bless him, O YHWH; place in my mouth the blessing of righteousness, that I may bless him.

25:14 at that hour, when the spirit of righteousness descended into her mouth, she placed both her hands on the head of Yaakov; said:

25:15 Blessed are you, the Creator of righteousness and Creator of the ages; may he bless you beyond all the generations of men. May he give you, my son, the path of righteousness; reveal righteousness to your seed.

25:16 may he make your sons many during your life; may they arise according to the number of the months of the year; may their sons become many and great beyond the stars of heaven; their numbers be more than the sand of the sea.

25:17 may he give them this fine land - as he said he would give it to Avraham and to his seed after him always - and may they hold it as a possession forever.

25:18 may I see, born to you, my son, blessed children during my life; a blessed and holy seed may all your seed be.

25:19 as you have refreshed your mother's spirit during her life, the womb of her that bore you blesses you thus - my affection and my breasts bless you; my mouth and my tongue praise you greatly.

25:20 Increase and spread over the earth; may your seed be perfect in the joy of heaven and earth forever; may your seed rejoice; on the great day of peace may it have peace.

25:21 may your name and your seed endure to all the ages; may the Most High Creator be their Creator; may the Creator of righteousness dwell with them; by them may his sanctuary be built to all the ages.

25:22 Blessed be he that blesses you; all flesh that curses you falsely, may it be cursed.

25:23 she kissed him; told him: May the Creator of the world love you, as the heart of your mother and her affection rejoice in you and bless you. And she ceased from blessing.
